sections.st: Diagnostic Kit Packaging Manufacturer India — IVD Kit Packaging GMP Cleanroom · Vapi
leads: Trizen Packaging manufactures diagnostic kit packaging from our Cleanroom Class 8, GMP-compliant, ISO 9001:2015 certified facility in Vapi, Gujarat — custom thermoformed multi-component trays for IVD diagnostic kits, rapid test kit packaging, clinical chemistry diagnostic packaging, and molecular diagnostic kit packaging. Diagnostic packaging manufacturer from Vapi for IVD companies, clinical diagnostic manufacturers, and rapid test kit companies.

Diagnostic kit packaging must organise multiple components — test cassettes, sample collection tubes, lancets, buffer bottles, pipettes, instruction leaflets — in a defined kit layout that supports correct diagnostic test execution. Every diagnostic kit component must be present, undamaged, and positioned correctly for the test procedure. A missing lancet, a contaminated test cassette, or a broken buffer bottle makes the diagnostic kit unusable — and in point-of-care diagnostic applications, an unusable kit delays patient treatment.

strips.title: Incomplete Diagnostic Kit — Missing Component at Point of Care
strips.desc: Problem: Diagnostic kit packaging where components are not individually held allows components to fall out — POC diagnostic kits arrive with missing lancets or test cassettes. Solution: Individual cavity for every kit component confirmed from complete kit contents list.

strips.title: Test Cassette Contamination — Cassette Patient Sample Zone Must Not Contact Packaging
strips.desc: Problem: Rapid test cassette packaging where the test cassette sample zone contacts packaging material can cause contamination of the test zone — false test results in clinical use. Solution: Test cassette cavity with clearance over the sample application zone — no packaging contact on the test cassette patient sample area.

strips.title: Reagent Vial Upright — Reagent Must Not Contact Stopper in Secondary Packaging
strips.desc: Problem: Reagent vials in diagnostic kits that are not maintained upright can have reagent contact the stopper — reagent-stopper interaction can affect reagent stability. Solution: PETG cavity designed to maintain reagent vials upright at all standard distribution orientations.
